name: Greifvogelpark Umhausen
kurzbeschreibung: The Umhausen Birds of Prey Park in Ötztal: 5,000 m² open-air arena at Stuibenfall with 30 birds of prey, spectacular flight shows, and a falconry educational trail.
beschreibung:
Overview

The spectacular Umhausen Birds of Prey Park is located at the foot of the mighty Stuibenfall – Tyrol's largest waterfall – in the front Ötztal (Imst district) at an altitude of around 1,040 meters. Nestled in a natural larch forest directly next to the famous Ötzi Village, the facility, built in accordance with monument and animal protection regulations, extends over an approximately 5,000 square meter open-air area. With around 30 species of birds of prey from all over the world, the park offers visitors of all ages fascinating insights into traditional alpine falconry, which is recognized by UNESCO as an intangible cultural heritage.

Route & Requirements

The heart of the park is the spacious free-flight arena with 300 seats: during the daily, approximately 45-minute flight shows, certified falconers present the majestic rulers of the skies in free flight against the impressive mountain backdrop of the Ötztal Alps. Visitors experience firsthand how snow-white snowy owls glide silently just above the heads of the spectators, how nimble peregrine falcons swoop down on the decoy in a rapid dive, and how mighty imperial eagles, golden eagles, and griffon vultures with wingspans of over 2.50 meters utilize thermal updrafts. The falconers explain in an exciting and educational way the hunting techniques, sensory abilities, and the indispensable ecological role of birds of prey as nature's health police.

Visit & Arrival

The Umhausen Birds of Prey Park is open from early May to late October, Tuesday to Sunday, from 10:00 to 17:00 (closed Mondays; open daily in July and August). Flight shows take place at 11:30 and 14:30 (on Sundays and public holidays also at 16:00; flight shows are cancelled in heavy rain or storms to protect the animals). Admission prices (as of season 2025/2026): Adults approx. €12.00, children and teenagers (6 to 15 years) approx. €6.50, toddlers free; combi ticket with Ötzi Village adults approx. €19.00, children approx. €10.50. Holders of the Ötztal Inside Summer Card enjoy free admission! Arrival by car: Via the Inntal motorway A12 (Ötztal exit), continue on the B186 for about 15 km to Umhausen, follow signs to the Bischoffsplatz/Ötzi-Dorf car park (paid, approx. €5.00 per day).

Tips

The entire Birds of Prey Park and the grandstand of the flight arena are barrier-free and wheelchair-accessible without steps; for safety reasons, dogs are not allowed in the park (free shaded dog boxes are available at the entrance). Combine your visit with a detour to the adjacent Ötzi Village and an easy hike to the first viewing platform of the Stuibenfall.
